title: Pricing
body:
Base prices in Robux. Designers may add tax at their discretion.

Pick a category below for the full list. Bulk discounts apply where noted. Your quote is confirmed in the ticket before you pay.

options.label: What we won't make
options.title: What We Won't Make
options.content:
No NSFW, gore, or disturbing content. No hate symbols, and nothing targeting real people.

No assets impersonating another group's branding, and nothing that breaks Roblox or Discord's rules.

Unsure? Ask before you pay.
